statements.verbatim_passage: High temperatures have a significant impact on the service life of asphalt pavements and are often the basis of determining the design of the pavement mixture and section. Asphalt becomes a plastomer that deforms under high-temperature conditions, and its shape cannot be completely recovered. Hence, asphalt pavements are prone to permanent deformation under the influence of repeated loading [24], and high temperatures are one of the main causes of the permanent deformation of asphalt pavements.
